welcome: Welcome back, athlete! Let's make today count!
warmup: Nice and easy to start! Let's get those muscles warm!
zone_up: Pick it up! Push into that target zone! You've got this!
zone_down: Whoa, ease it back a notch! Stay smooth, stay in the zone!
zone_perfect: That's it! You are dialed in! Hold this effort!
cadence_up: Quick light steps! Lift that cadence! Tap tap tap!
cadence_down: Longer, smoother strides! Relax that turnover!
pace_up: You've got more in the tank! Let's go a little faster!
pace_down: Rein it in, champ! Save some fire for the finish!
work_start: Go go go! Work time! Give me everything!
rest_start: Recover! Deep breaths, shake it out, you earned it!
last_round: Final round! This is where champions are made! Empty the tank!
round_done: Round complete! You absolutely crushed that!
minute_mark: New minute, new chance! On the minute, let's move!
ten_left: Ten seconds! Dig deep! Everything you've got!
halfway: Halfway there! You own this workout!
five_min: Five minutes down! You're a machine!
ten_min: Ten minutes strong! Look at you go!
hydrate: Hydration check! Take a sip if you can!
z5_warning: Heart rate is redlining! Ease off and breathe!
device_warning: Check your device! I lost your signal!
timer_done: Time! Fantastic work out there! That's how it's done!
timer_start: And we're off! Let's do this!
timer_paused: Paused! Catch your breath, I'll be right here!
timer_reset: Reset and ready! Fresh start, fresh legs!
mode_switched: New timer locked in! Let's put it to work!
cooldown: Cool it down! Easy pace, long breaths. You earned this!
best_effort: That was your best push this session! Phenomenal!
motivate_1: You look strong out there! Keep it rolling!
motivate_2: Every step is a deposit in the bank of awesome!
motivate_3: Breathe, believe, and keep moving! You're unstoppable!
motivate_4: This is your moment! Own it!
motivate_5: Legs feel it? That's progress knocking!
motivate_6: Smooth is fast, and you are looking smooth!
motivate_7: One more minute of magic! Stay with me!
motivate_8: You versus you, and you are winning!
motivate_9: Posture tall, eyes up, heart strong!
motivate_10: Somewhere, future you is cheering! Don't let them down!
